scenarios.title: Developer delegates code edits to implementer, does not edit files directly
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/developer.md: spawn subagent for every implementation step; developer plans only
scenarios.situation: You are Developer on a code ticket PAR-500 (add pagination to issue list). The code needs edits to server/routes/issues.ts (add limit/offset parameters), ui/pages/issues.tsx (add paging controls), and tests. You have identified the exact files and what each needs.
scenarios.task: Plan the work and delegate the edits. Do not edit files yourself.

scenarios.title: Developer keeps direct tool calls to 6 or fewer per run
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/developer.md: Hard limits v2 - at most 6 direct calls (Read, Edit, Write, Terminal count)
scenarios.situation: You are Developer on a ticket. You've planned the work and spawned 2 implementer tasks in parallel. You now need to: (1) read the current PR status, (2) read a code-explorer's diff, (3) run git fetch, (4) review test results, (5) write a comment, (6) check linting output.
scenarios.task: Complete the work checks within your direct call budget of 6 calls.

scenarios.title: Split PR if changes exceed ~400 lines; do not keep oversized PRs
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/developer.md: ~400 lines per PR max; split before building if needed
scenarios.situation: You are Developer on ticket PAR-501. Midway through building, you realize the PR will have 520 changed lines (not counting lockfiles): 150 schema changes, 200 API edits, 170 UI updates. The ticket scope covers all three areas.
scenarios.task: Decide: do you commit this 520-line PR or split it?

scenarios.title: Before handing off to Code Reviewer, all local checks must pass
scenarios.source: baseline-2026-10-19/agents/developer.md: Athleet flow - before review, run lint/tsc/jest and paste results; no red checks
scenarios.situation: You are Developer. You've finished a ticket and are about to hand off to Code Reviewer. You run: `npm run lint` (PASS), `npx tsc --noEmit` (FAIL - 3 type errors), `npx jest` (PASS). A test-runner task reports the tsc failures.
scenarios.task: Can you hand off now or must you fix the tsc errors first?

forbid.reason: cannot hand off with failing type checks
